data.name: Medha
data.gender_notes: Medha is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit medhā, 'wisdom, intelligence, memory'. Its root is Sanskrit medhā (मेधा). A classical Sanskrit term for wisdom. Medha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Wisdom; intelligence; memory”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Medha expresses “Wisdom; intelligence; memory”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit medhā, 'wisdom, intelligence, memory'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Medha total 22, reducing to 4. Number 4 is associated with discipline, order and steady effort.
